misconceptions.statement: Passing faeces is also excretion, the same as passing urine.
misconceptions.why: Both are 'waste leaving the body' in everyday talk.
misconceptions.fix: Faeces are undigested food that never entered the cells, so removing them is egestion. Excretion removes wastes made by the body's own cells.

probe.question: Is the removal of faeces excretion? Why?
probe.wrong_answer: Yes, because it is waste leaving the body.
